title: Reorganize repository into root shell layout
summary: Moved the repository to a small root-shell layout with backend Python under the mediapipeline namespace, desktop/WebView assets under apps, operational pipeline and release assets under ops, tests grouped by responsibility, and generated docs under docs/generated.
reason: The root previously mixed implementation modules, desktop app files, pipeline scripts, tests, generated summaries, runtime logs, and release assets. The new layout makes ownership and tooling boundaries explicit while keeping only conventional root-bound controls and manifests at the repository root.
behavior_before: Root-level and legacy top-level folders contained Python implementation modules, desktop/WebView code, pipeline scripts, tests, summaries, runtime logs, and release support files with many imports and scripts relying on the old DesktopApp, Pipeline, app, scripts, and summaries paths.
behavior_after: Root is limited to repository controls, package/tool manifests, root human docs, and grouped project trees. Python imports resolve through src/mediapipeline, WebView/Tauri assets live under apps/desktop, PowerShell pipeline and release assets live under ops, tests live under tests/python and tests/webview, and generated navigation output lives under docs/generated.

rollback_plan: Revert the repository layout migration as one change set: restore the old DesktopApp, Pipeline, scripts, app, summaries, and root runtime/log paths; revert pyproject/package/pre-commit/docs/test import updates; and rerun the full unittest discovery plus root stale-path scans. Do not partially roll back individual moved modules without also restoring their import, launcher, packaging, and generated-summary references.
notes: This packet records the broad layout migration and validation outcome. Directory-level files_touched entries cover intentional old-path deletions and new-path additions for the root-shell migration. The root-bound policy is documented in README.md and AGENTS.md.
